March 4, 2018 - By Hugh Holland 
Chao Ku decreased its stake in Target Corp (Call) (TGT) by 64.97% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Nine Masts Capital Ltd sold 1,949 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.90% while stock markets rallied. The hedge fund run by Chao Ku held 1,051 shares of the department and specialty retail stores company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $218,000, down from 3,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Nine Masts Capital Ltd who had been investing in Target Corp (Call) for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $40.85 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.38% or $1.02 during the last trading session, reaching $75.15. About 4.96M shares traded. Target Corporation (NYSE:TGT) has declined 16.51% since March 4, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 33.21% the S&P500. 
Cadinha & Co Llc increased its stake in Bristol (BMY) by 1025% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cadinha & Co Llc bought 161,540 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.04% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 177,300 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $11.30M, up from 15,760 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cadinha & Co Llc who had been investing in Bristol for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $108.03 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.73% or $0.48 during the last trading session, reaching $66.17. About 5.39 million shares traded. Bristol-Myers Squibb Company (NYSE:BMY) has declined 23.19% since March 4, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 39.89% the S&P500. 
Nine Masts Capital Ltd, which manages about $674.93M US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Nvidia Corp (Put) (NASDAQ:NVDA) by 1,050 shares to 1,750 shares, valued at $580,000 in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Boeing Co (NYSE:BA) by 3,964 shares in the quarter, for a total of 4,264 shares, and has risen its stake in American Intl Group Inc (NYSE:AIG). 
Analysts await Target Corporation (NYSE:TGT) to report earnings on March, 6 before the open. They expect $1.39 EPS, down 4.14% or $0.06 from last year’s $1.45 per share. TGT’s profit will be $755.58 million for 13.52 P/E if the $1.39 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.91 actual EPS reported by Target Corporation for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 52.75% EPS growth. 
Among 28 analysts covering Target Corporation ( NYSE:TGT ), 10 have Buy rating, 3 Sell and 15 Hold. Therefore 36% are positive.
